summary: The construction correctly uses accepted fact 44d417ab69032c1f. The full-mass constraint forces g=1 almost everywhere, and the accepted centroid identity verifies its moment feasibility. The finite choice lambda=0 and eta=2 gives a valid strict KKT upper-capacity rule because ell is at most 1 on the entire body, so the adjusted sublevel cap is exactly C_{n,d}. The halfspace orientation, nonzero continuous normal, mixed centroid, intrinsic affine rank r=n, exact mixed-volume ratio 1/(3^{n/2}+1), asymptotic decay relative to 1/(r+1), and rank-only scope of the resulting impossibility claim are all correct, including d=1 and measure-zero boundary fibers.
